formats.name: Standard Format
formats.description: The primary competitive format played in official Pokémon World Championships. Uses cards with modern regulation marks.
formats.copy_limit: Maximum 4 copies of any card with the same name (except Basic Energy)
advantages: Lower barrier of entry from older sets

formats.name: Expanded Format
formats.description: Permits cards starting from the Black & White series (2011) to the latest modern releases. Enables explosive GX/EX combos and deep synergy archetypes.
formats.copy_limit: Maximum 4 copies of any card with the same name
disadvantages: Requires familiarity with the Expanded banlist

formats.name: Casual / Kitchen Table
formats.description: Open format designed for friendly matches with friends and family. Perfect for experimenting with fun thematic decks without competitive pressure.
formats.copy_limit: Generally 4 copies, customizable per house rules
advantages: Use any card in your collection
disadvantages: Potential power disparity if unmatched cards are used

deck_building_rules.title: The 60-Card Rule
deck_building_rules.content: Every deck must contain exactly 60 cards — no more, no less. Your deck cannot run out of cards when drawing at the start of your turn, or you lose the game.

deck_building_rules.title: 4-Copy Limit per Name
deck_building_rules.content: You may include up to 4 copies of cards sharing the exact same name (e.g. max 4 Eevee, even with different artwork). Basic Energy cards have no quantity limit.

deck_building_rules.title: Basic Pokémon Requirement
deck_building_rules.content: Your deck MUST contain at least 1 Basic Pokémon to start the match. If your opening 7-card hand contains no Basic Pokémon, declare a Mulligan (reshuffle and draw 7 new cards, granting the opponent 1 extra card).

deck_building_rules.title: Prize Trade Mechanics
deck_building_rules.content: Knocking out a regular Pokémon awards 1 Prize card. Knocking out a Pokémon-GX or Pokémon-ex awards 2 Prizes. Knocking out a TAG TEAM awards 3 Prizes. The first player to take all 6 Prizes wins!

trainer_types.rule: You may play as many Item cards as you like during your turn.
trainer_types.examples: Nest Ball, Timer Ball, Switch, Escape Rope, Rescue Stretcher

trainer_types.rule: You may only play 1 Supporter card per turn. (The player going first cannot play a Supporter on Turn 1).
trainer_types.examples: Professor's Research, Boss's Orders, Cynthia, Guzma

trainer_types.rule: You may play only 1 Stadium per turn. The Stadium stays in play providing global effects to both players until a new Stadium replaces it.
You may attach 1 Tool per Pokémon (unless an ability permits more). The tool remains attached until the Pokémon is knocked out or discarded.
trainer_types.examples: Escape Board, Metal Goggles, Wishful Baton, Weakness Policy

special_conditions.name: Poisoned
special_conditions.effect: Place 1 damage counter (10 damage or more) on the Poisoned Pokémon between turns.
special_conditions.cure: Retreating to the bench, evolving, or playing a card like Switch.

special_conditions.name: Burned
special_conditions.effect: Place 2 damage counters (20 damage) between turns. Then flip a coin: heads cures the condition.
special_conditions.cure: Flipping heads between turns, retreating to the bench, or evolving.

special_conditions.name: Asleep
special_conditions.effect: Turn the card 90 degrees counter-clockwise. The Asleep Pokémon cannot attack or retreat. Flip a coin between turns: heads wakes up.
special_conditions.cure: Flipping heads, evolving, or using switching cards like Switch.

special_conditions.name: Paralyzed
special_conditions.effect: Turn the card 90 degrees clockwise. The Paralyzed Pokémon cannot attack or retreat. Lasts until the end of its owner next turn.
special_conditions.cure: Cures automatically after the player turn ends, or via switching/evolving.

special_conditions.name: Confused
special_conditions.effect: Turn the card 180 degrees upside down. When attempting to attack, flip a coin: tails means the attack fails and the Pokémon takes 30 damage to itself!
special_conditions.cure: Retreating to the bench or evolving.
